args.message:
Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The nightly build of tests/test_money.py expects banker's rounding,
but src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP. Switch the quantize rounding mode
to ROUND_HALF_EVEN to match the documented FIN-212 behavior.

args.head: fix/money-round-half-even
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch the `quantize` rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the function's existing docstring and the FIN-212 requirement.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986` (branch `fix/money-round-half-even`).
- Example fixes: `2.675 -> 2.68` (up, since 7 is odd → rounds to even 8), `2.665 -> 2.66` (down, since 6 is already even).

Per policy, I did not merge into main — it awaits alex's review approval.
